History of Ancient Trade between India & China
# The ancient trade history between India and China dates back thousands of years.
# The Han Dynasty of China (206 BCE–25 CE) established the Silk Road, a key trade network.
# The Southern Silk Road and Maritime Silk Road passed through India, facilitating trade.
# India exported textiles, precious stones, and spices, while China traded silk, iron, and ceramics.
# This trade route also played a vital role in the spread of Buddhism from India to China.
